records.lore_purpose: Serve civilian life and the Oath tension while retaining its locked elemental and cultural identity.
records.gameplay_purpose: Consistent light calibration, measured shader cost, UV scale, physical response and licensing
records.visual_signature: Sleeveless exoskeletal ninja and long power-pack coat; large modular cylinders, hinges and piston limbs

materials.rule: Preserve observed material hierarchy; any new finish requires review.

records.shape_language: Sleeveless exoskeletal ninja and long power-pack coat; large modular cylinders, hinges and piston limbs

palette.description: gunmetal; charcoal; safety orange
palette.rule: Preserve per-reference variants; no universal recolor or new hex palette silently approved.

scale.requirements: Calibrate against human scale/traversal envelope; dimensions are not approved from image labels alone.

animation_requirements: Load, lock, recoil, vent; force is readable through mechanism displacement
Author required state transitions, interruption, recovery and root-motion policy; no shipped clips implied.
vfx_requirements: Load, lock, recoil, vent; force is readable through mechanism displacement
Use source castable behavior when applicable; separate cosmetic response from authority.
audio_requirements: Piston impacts, ratchet lock, motor whine and metallic recoil
Authoring requirement only; no recovered realm audio files.
environment_interactions: Use contract-interaction-resolver; interactions bounded by object tags and owner scope.
Provide active, resolved and recovery state without permanent content loss.

model_construction.acceptance: Consistent light calibration, measured shader cost, UV scale, physical response and licensing
model_construction.civilian_context: Actuator bench, assembly jig, recycling press
model_construction.architecture_context: Industrial rail bays, modular gantries and kinetic fortifications

lod_requirements: Author baseline/mid/high variants after target hardware is selected.
Preserve silhouette, gameplay tell and socket positions at distance.
Independent visual LOD must never alter authoritative hit shape.
collision_requirements: Use simple authored collision according to role; decorative detail is not collidable by default.
Separate movement/navigation, hit detection and interaction volumes.
Validate collision/nav swaps for every authored state.

requirements: Measure geometry, materials, overdraw, rig cost, memory and streaming in representative scenes.
No unmeasured performance claim or numerical budget approval.

approval.required_gate: Explicit review of exact artifact/version and intended scope; progression messages do not approve individual images.

validation.acceptance_gate: Consistent light calibration, measured shader cost, UV scale, physical response and licensing
